Three things students get wrong about co.zh: 学生对卷积的三个常见误解
Three things students get wrong about co.src: Three things students get wrong about convolution

Not quite. Matrix multiplication combine.zh: 并不尽然。矩阵乘法将每一行与每一列两两组合。卷积则是@@T0@@局部的@@T1@@：将卷积核与一小块输入区域逐元素相乘，再求和得到一个标量。随后卷积核@@T2@@滑动@@T3@@到下一块区域。这种局部性（参数在各位置间共享）正是 CNN 具有平移等变性、且参数远少于全连接层的原因。
Not quite. Matrix multiplication combine.src: Not quite. Matrix multiplication combines every row with every column. Convolution is local: an element-wise product between the kernel and a small input patch, summed to one scalar. The kernel then slides to the next patch. This locality (parameters shared across positions) is what gives CNNs translation equivariance and dramatically fewer parameters than a dense layer.

\"The output is always smaller than the.src: "The output is always smaller than the input."

Only with @@T0@@zero padding@@T1@@. Cran.zh:
只有在@@T0@@零填充@@T1@@的情况下才如此。将填充滑块调到
        @@T2@@P = 1@@T3@@、卷积核尺寸 @@T4@@K = 3@@T5@@ 时，输出的空间尺寸与输入@@T6@@相同@@T7@@ —— 即「same」填充。现代深度 CNN 几乎处处使用 same 填充，从而不会因输入分辨率而限制网络深度。
Only with @@T0@@zero padding@@T1@@. Cran.src: Only with zero padding. Crank the padding slider to P = 1 with kernel size K = 3 and the output is the same spatial size as the input — "same" padding. Modern deep CNNs use same padding almost everywhere so the network depth isn't capped by the input resolution.

\"Convolution and cross-correlation are.src: "Convolution and cross-correlation are the same thing."

Mathematically they aren't — true convol.zh:
从数学上讲二者并不相同 —— 真正的卷积会翻转卷积核。
        在深度学习中，我们几乎总是实现@@T0@@互相关@@T1@@，却称之为卷积；反正网络会自行学习卷积核，因此翻转与否无关紧要。信号处理文献对这一区分则严格得多。
Mathematically they aren't — true convol.src: Mathematically they aren't — true convolution flips the kernel. In deep learning we almost always implement cross-correlation and call it convolution; the network learns the kernels anyway, so the flip doesn't matter. The signal-processing literature is stricter about the distinction.

Where this fits in the CNN story.src: Where this fits in the CNN story

@@T0@@The kernels you see here are hand-.zh:
@@T0@@你在此看到的卷积核是手工设计的@@T1@@ —— 边缘（水平/竖直）、
      锐化、模糊都是图像处理中的经典核。而在 CNN 中，网络从数据里
      @@T2@@学习@@T3@@ 卷积核的取值。第一个卷积层通常最终会学到类似 Gabor 的边缘检测器，其外观与你正在把玩的这些核惊人地相似。可视化 AlexNet 第一层学到的滤波器之所以成为深度学习中被复现最多的图之一，原因正在于此。
@@T0@@The kernels you see here are hand-.src: The kernels you see here are hand-designed — Edge (H/V), Sharpen, Blur are classics from image processing. In a CNN the network learns the kernel values from data. The first conv layer typically ends up learning Gabor-like edge detectors that look uncannily similar to the ones you're playing with. Visualising the learned filters of AlexNet's first layer is one of the most-reproduced figures in deep learning for exactly this reason.

@@T0@@Stride controls downsampling.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@步长控制下采样。@@T1@@ 步长为 2 时，每一步都将空间维度减半 —— 这是最大池化的经典替代方案。ResNet-50 在每个阶段的起始处使用步长为 2 的卷积，而非池化。
      在上方试试步长 2，观察输出恰好按该倍数缩小。
@@T0@@Stride controls downsampling.@@T1@.src: Stride controls downsampling. Stride 2 halves the spatial dimension at each step — the classic alternative to max-pooling. ResNet-50 uses stride-2 convolutions at the start of each stage instead of pooling. Try stride 2 above and watch the output shrink by exactly that factor.

@@T0@@Receptive field grows with depth.@.zh:
@@T0@@感受野随深度增长。@@T1@@ 一个 3×3 卷积看到 3×3 的区域。两个堆叠的 3×3 卷积看到 5×5 的区域。@@T2@@k@@T3@@ 个堆叠的 3×3 卷积看到 @@T4@@(2k+1)×(2k+1)@@T5@@ 的区域，而每层参数数量不变。这正是 VGG 带来阶梯式跃升的原因 —— 用一个 7×7 替换为三个 3×3，在相同感受野下参数更少、非线性更多。实时演示参见
      @@T6@@感受野一文@@T7@@。
@@T0@@Receptive field grows with depth.@.src: Receptive field grows with depth. One 3×3 conv sees a 3×3 patch. Two stacked 3×3 convs see a 5×5 patch. k stacked 3×3 convs see a (2k+1)×(2k+1) patch with the same parameter count per layer. This is why VGG was a step change — replacing one 7×7 with three 3×3s gave the same receptive field at fewer parameters and more non-linearities. See the receptive-field article for a live demo.

@@T0@@Sliding-window cost.@@T1@@ A K×K c.src: Sliding-window cost. A K×K conv on a W×W feature map at stride 1 does W² · K² · C_in · C_out multiply-adds. For ResNet-50 on 224×224 input the first conv layer alone is ~118M MACs — this is why ImageNet training was a GPU watershed moment.

meta.title: 卷积，逐步演示
meta.tagline: 观察卷积核在图像上滑动，一次一个点积
meta.summary: 选择一个 3×3 卷积核 —— 边缘检测、锐化、模糊，或你自己设计的 —— 然后逐个位置地推进一次卷积。观察被高亮的输入区域、卷积核内部的逐元素乘积，以及逐步构建出的输出特征图。可实时调整填充与步长。这正是每一个 CNN 的运作机理，毫无保留地呈现。
highlights: 五个预设卷积核 —— 水平边缘、竖直边缘、锐化、模糊，以及一个完全可编辑的自定义 3×3。
步进 / 播放 / 重置控件让你可以一次走一个点积，或实时观看卷积核扫过整幅图像。
中间面板展示当前位置处精确的输入 × 卷积核乘积 —— 是卷积的算术本身，而非抽象概念。
填充滑块（0–2）与步长选择器（1–2）—— 调整时实时观察输出网格改变尺寸。
以 KaTeX 实时渲染输出维度公式并代入真实数值：O = ⌊(W − K + 2P)/S⌋ + 1。
